data.title: Bind compiled shared overlays by exact hash and fix perf ACK framing
data.description: Changes the validation strategy: exact raw-byte SHA-256 pins for every shared overlay source are now the binding layer over the bytes staged for compilation. Fragment, ordering, reachability, shadowing, and macro checks remain only as diagnostics for intentional pin updates, with their Rust name-resolution limitations documented. The runtime fix consumes exact ack LF NUL frames, preserves the ack-LF ledger, and emits perf_disable canonically. All hostile cases including custom read_exact, assert_eq aliasing, and monotonic clock shadowing fail by hash mismatch; all suites and real perf/strace rehearsals pass.
